title: Generic Insurance-Intelligence Hardening with Star Comprehensive Pilot Proof
architecture_principle: Every P2 unit must produce a reusable generic capability or governance artifact first, then prove it using Star Comprehensive as the bounded pilot. Product-specific fixtures, governed records and evaluation cases may reference Star; generic contracts, evaluators, runners and decision logic must not depend on Star identifiers or semantics.
objective: Build and harden generic topic-profile, publication-governance, adversarial-evaluation and bypass-control capabilities, then certify their first bounded application using Star Comprehensive without expanding product scope or weakening safety boundaries.
entry_criteria: Generic topic completeness and rule certification infrastructure remains unchanged unless a defect is proven.
Star conditional-copayment and room-rent certification cases remain deterministic PASS as pilot fixtures.
All existing repository tests pass before each bounded unit begins.

generic_layer: Contracts, schemas, registries, evaluators, runners and decision logic use domain-neutral identifiers and behavior.
Generic code must not import Star-specific fixtures, governed records or constants.
A generic capability is accepted only when its behavior can be exercised with non-Star data without code modification.
pilot_layer: Star-specific artifacts are limited to governed evidence, topic profiles, certification fixtures, publication records and evaluation cases.
Star pilot proof must invoke the generic layer through its public contracts.
Pilot-specific limitations cannot weaken or bypass generic acceptance rules.

execution_units.name: Generic topic-profile requirements with Star pilot profiles
execution_units.purpose: Define a reusable governed topic-profile mechanism that declares the component set required before explanation is permitted, then apply it to Star pilot topics.

deliverables: A versioned generic topic-profile contract or schema referencing registered topic IDs and versions.
A generic profile validator or evaluator integration that uses the existing topic completeness evaluator.
Deterministic tests for COMPLETE, PARTIAL, CONFLICTING and NOT_AVAILABLE outcomes using generic fixtures.
pass_conditions: Profiles declare required and optional components without product-specific code paths.
Explanation permission remains derived by the generic evaluator and is status-sensitive.
The profile mechanism can be reused by another insurer or product without changing its contract or evaluator.

deliverables: Machine-readable Star pilot profiles for the selected certified topics.
Star regression cases proving missing trigger, exception, scope, consequence or other required semantics block explanation where applicable.
pass_conditions: Each Star profile references an existing registered generic topic and exact version.
No Star-only exception bypasses the generic profile validator or completeness evaluator.

blocked_conditions: A required generic profile behavior can only be implemented with Star-specific branching.
A required pilot component cannot be mapped to governed evidence.
The profile depends on unregistered or inferred semantics.
Explanation permission cannot be derived deterministically.

execution_units.name: Generic rule-certification reuse with a third Star pilot rule
execution_units.purpose: Prove that the existing generic certification capability supports an additional materially different rule, using Star as the pilot fixture rather than adding Star-specific infrastructure.

deliverables: No new product-specific behavior in generic certification contracts, runner or topic catalogue.
Reusable mutation-test patterns for missing, conflicting and authority-invalid evidence.
pass_conditions: The existing generic runner and contracts execute the case unchanged.
Mutation behavior is expressed through generic evidence and completeness contracts.
Any discovered generic defect is corrected without embedding Star identifiers or semantics.

deliverables: One governed Star certification case using an existing generic topic materially different from conditional copayment and room-rent coverage limit.
Authoritative source, version, page and lineage trace.
Mutation tests proving missing or conflicting semantics block certification.
pass_conditions: The Star rule is not a restatement of copayment or room-rent logic.
The intact case produces deterministic PASS and defined mutations produce BLOCKED or FAIL.

blocked_conditions: No authoritative governed Star rule is available for a materially different registered topic.
The case requires weakening generic contracts or inventing unsupported semantics.
The generic runner requires a Star-specific code path.

execution_units.name: Generic publication-decision capability with Star decisions
execution_units.purpose: Build a reusable governed transition from certified knowledge to an explicit publication decision, then apply it to the Star pilot rules.

deliverables: A versioned publication-decision contract supporting PUBLISH, WITHHOLD and BLOCKED.
A deterministic generic decision builder, evaluator or validator.
Generic validation of certification references, evidence trace, limitations, decision reasons and decision status.
pass_conditions: Publication status is explicit and never inferred from file presence.
A bound_not_published rule cannot be treated as published.
The decision capability contains no product-specific branching and accepts any governed subject reference.

deliverables: A publication decision record for each certified Star pilot rule.
Trace from each Star decision to certification and governed evidence outputs.
pass_conditions: Every Star pilot rule has an explicit PUBLISH, WITHHOLD or BLOCKED decision.
Each decision preserves rule-specific limitations and non-guarantee language.

blocked_conditions: Publication status is implicit, missing or inferred from file presence.
A decision lacks traceability or safety limitations.
The generic decision capability depends on Star-specific identifiers.

execution_units.name: Generic authoritative-publication capability with Star publication proof
execution_units.purpose: Build a reusable authoritative publication gate that admits only approved decisions, then prove it with Star pilot records.

deliverables: A versioned authoritative-publication contract and deterministic publication gate.
Negative tests proving WITHHOLD and BLOCKED decisions cannot produce authoritative publication.
Immutable generic trace from publication record to decision, certification, evidence and source version.
pass_conditions: Publication cannot occur without an approved PUBLISH decision.
Published semantics must be an exact governed projection of the certified rule.
The publication gate is reusable across products and topics without code modification.

deliverables: Authoritative Star publication records only for rules approved by P2.3.
Star negative cases proving withheld or blocked rules remain unpublished.
pass_conditions: Published Star records preserve exact certified semantics and complete lineage.
No Star publication record claims or guarantees claim payment.

blocked_conditions: Publication can occur without an approved decision.
Published semantics diverge from the certified rule.
Traceability is incomplete.
The publication gate contains Star-specific branching.

execution_units.name: Generic adversarial-evaluation capability with Star pilot dataset
execution_units.purpose: Build a reusable adversarial case contract, runner and result model, then execute the first bounded dataset against the Star pilot path.

deliverables: A versioned generic adversarial-case catalogue contract.
A deterministic evaluation runner and result record independent of product identity.
Generic failure classification for hallucination, omission, scope drift, recommendation leakage, status loss and claim-payment guarantee language.
pass_conditions: Evaluation inputs and expected outcomes are machine-readable and reproducible.
Criticality, failure class, actual outcome and trace references are recorded deterministically.
The runner can execute a non-Star catalogue without code modification.

deliverables: A versioned Star adversarial case catalogue.
An executable Star evaluation result record covering the complete governed pilot path.
pass_conditions: All critical Star safety cases pass.
No unsupported recommendation or claim-payment guarantee is emitted.
Warnings, limitations and partial or blocked statuses reach the final governed output.
Every Star failure is reproducible and classified.

blocked_conditions: Any critical safety case fails.
Evaluation results are nondeterministic or lack traceability.
A known critical failure is accepted without an explicit blocking decision.
The evaluation runner embeds Star-specific behavior.

execution_units.name: Generic bypass inventory and control with Star reachability proof
execution_units.purpose: Create a reusable inventory and disposition model for legacy recommendation-capable paths, then prove that no unsafe bypass is reachable in the Star pilot.

deliverables: A versioned bypass-inventory and disposition contract.
A reusable classification vocabulary: removed, routed, blocked or explicitly deferred.
Generic regression patterns for implicit recommendation language and safety-gate bypass attempts.
pass_conditions: Every discovered recommendation-capable path has an explicit disposition and reachability status.
All active recommendation-capable paths route through the governed safety gate.
Deferred paths must be disabled or demonstrably unreachable for any certified pilot.

deliverables: A Star pilot reachability view over the generic bypass inventory.
Regression tests showing no classified unsafe path can influence Star pilot output.
pass_conditions: No active unclassified bypass path remains reachable in the Star pilot.
Implicit recommendation detection covers the Star pilot adversarial cases.

blocked_conditions: An active recommendation bypass remains unclassified.
A deferred path can still influence pilot output.
Implicit recommendation detection remains materially incomplete.
Bypass control is implemented only for Star-specific call paths.

execution_units.name: Generic hardening and Star pilot certification closure
execution_units.purpose: Issue separate bounded decisions for generic capability readiness and the Star Comprehensive pilot application.

deliverables: A machine-readable generic P2 capability-closure record.
Merge and test evidence for generic deliverables from P2.1 through P2.6.
Final PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED outcome for generic capability readiness.
pass_conditions: All mandatory generic capability deliverables from P2.1 through P2.6 are PASS.
No generic contract, evaluator, runner, decision gate or control depends on Star identifiers or semantics.
Cross-product reuse is demonstrated by contract-level or fixture-level tests.

deliverables: A separate machine-readable Star pilot certification closure record.
Merge, publication and adversarial-test evidence for all Star pilot proofs.
Final PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED outcome with unresolved pilot limitations.
pass_conditions: All Star pilot proofs from P2.1 through P2.6 are PASS.
All critical Star adversarial cases pass.
Star publication boundaries are proven.
No active legacy recommendation bypass remains reachable in the Star pilot.
The full repository suite passes.

blocked_conditions: Any mandatory generic capability or Star pilot proof is FAIL or BLOCKED.
Any critical safety case fails.
Publication or bypass status remains ambiguous.
A generic capability is implemented through Star-specific branching.

pass: All mandatory generic capability deliverables pass in sequence.
All Star pilot proofs pass without weakening the generic layer.
All critical safety and publication-boundary tests pass.
The final repository suite passes without excluding existing tests.
Generic capability readiness and Star pilot certification are recorded as separate decisions.
fail: A deterministic generic or pilot requirement is implemented incorrectly but can be corrected within scope.
A non-critical adversarial case fails and is not yet resolved.
blocked: Authoritative evidence is unavailable for a mandatory pilot proof.
A critical safety or publication-boundary failure remains.
An active legacy recommendation bypass remains reachable.
A required generic capability can only be implemented with product-specific branching.
The final outcome would require inventing semantics or weakening governance.

included: Generic topic-profile, publication-governance, adversarial-evaluation and bypass-control capabilities.
Existing generic topic completeness and rule certification infrastructure.
Star Comprehensive as the first bounded pilot proof only.
excluded: Product comparison, ranking or suitability engines.
